name: marklingo
description: Translate Markdown through OpenRouter while preserving structure, links, code, and frontmatter.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: MarkLingo reads Markdown documents and can send their content to a configured translation endpoint, so the workspace should be trusted before translation runs.

virtualWorkspaces.description: MarkLingo currently writes translated files using local filesystem paths and does not support virtual workspace file systems.

commands.title: MarkLingo: Translate All Markdown in This Folder
MarkLingo: Delete Current Project Translated Files

enumDescriptions: Use a custom OpenAI-compatible API endpoint, such as llama.cpp server.

marklingo.openrouter.baseUrl.description: Active provider base URL kept for compatibility. MarkLingo Settings remembers OpenAI Compatible Base URL separately.

marklingo.openrouter.modelId.description: Active provider model ID kept for compatibility. Prefer MarkLingo Settings for provider-specific model values.

marklingo.providers.openrouter.modelId.description: Model ID remembered for the OpenRouter provider.

marklingo.providers.openaiCompatible.bas.description: Base URL remembered for the OpenAI Compatible provider.

marklingo.providers.openaiCompatible.mod.description: Model ID remembered for the OpenAI Compatible provider.

marklingo.translation.maxBlocksPerReques.description: Fallback max number of blocks per API request when the model context window cannot be read.

marklingo.translation.maxContextUsageRat.description: Max share of the model context window used for each translation request prompt when context length is available.

enumDescriptions: Use the verified provider/model capability when available; otherwise use Chat JSON.
Ask chat models to return a JSON object keyed by block ID.
Ask translation models to translate Markdown fields in small same-shape JSON batches.
marklingo.translation.requestMode.description: Advanced translation request mode. Normally managed by MarkLingo Settings Save and Verify.

marklingo.translation.translationModelMa.description: Maximum number of Markdown blocks per request for translation-model mode.

marklingo.translation.translationModelCo.description: Maximum concurrent requests for translation-model mode.

marklingo.translation.translationModelMa.description: Maximum output tokens per request for translation-model mode. Use 0 to estimate from the model context window.

marklingo.translation.targetLanguage.description: Target language for translation (shown in onboarding on first use).

marklingo.translation.targetLanguageCust.description: Custom target language used when targetLanguage is Custom...

marklingo.translation.systemPrompt.description: Advanced override for the base system prompt template (not shown in the MarkLingo settings panel). Leave empty to use the extension default. Use {targetLanguage} as the target language placeholder. Editing this can break Markdown and placeholder protection, so most users should use Custom Instructions instead.

marklingo.translation.customPrompt.description: Custom instructions appended after the built-in translation prompt, such as terminology or style rules. The base Markdown and placeholder protection always applies.

scripts.check:integration: npm run check && npm run test:vscode
scripts.package: npm run compile && npm run bundle
scripts.package:dry: npm run package && npx --no-install vsce ls --tree
scripts.vsix: npm run check && npx --no-install vsce package
